methodology_note: Verified October 2026 against published Cisco Webex, Microsoft 365 / Teams (NCE), Zoom Workplace, Google Workspace, RingCentral, Nextiva, and Dialpad US commercial rate cards plus FCC Universal Service Fund (USF) & Kari's Law / RAY BAUM's Act E911 regulatory recovery schedules.

merit_only_voip_rule.description: Dedicated VoIP alternatives (Dialpad, Nextiva, RingCentral) are surfaced ONLY when their calculated all-in 12-month TCO is strictly lower than BOTH Cisco Webex and Microsoft Teams for the user's exact configuration. Users are NEVER steered away from Cisco Webex or Microsoft Teams when Webex or Microsoft is the lower-cost or better-fit option (e.g., when M365 Business/Enterprise or Webex Suite is already licensed or cheaper).
